overrides.old: Advantages of a prefabricated precast data center

overrides.new: Elevated support for chillers, tanks, and cooling equipment above the building — preserving grade-level circulation and site perimeter.
Clear spans support heavy equipment and flexible layouts — customizable beam profile and spacing accommodates most chiller models.
Structural embeds allow direct mechanical and electrical connections — plant-installed Unistrut supports chilled-water piping and related equipment.
Day 1 & Day 2 zones enable infrastructure expansion without redesign — future capacity planned from the start.
Plant-installed Unistrut and embeds enable piping, cable trays, and AHUs to be hung directly from the structure without field drilling.
Built-in raceways and supports streamline field installation of MEP and electrical systems.

overrides.new: AccelDeck™ moves chillers and primary distribution above the data center — keeping grade-level circulation, walls, and site perimeter clean. texts.c: Elevated mechanical platform vs. at-grade mechanical yard

AccelDeck™ moves chillers and primary distribution above the data center — keeping grade-level circulation, walls, and site perimeter clean. The prefabricated platform organizes routing, access, embeds, and equipment support into one repeatable system for faster, more predictable installation.

Traditional at-grade chiller yards consume valuable site area and crowd the perimeter with exposed equipment, piping, headers, and field-built steel — increasing trade coordination, constraining access, and reducing flexibility for generators, electrical yards, and future expansion.

overrides.old: What is Infinite Facade® and what's included?

A unitized prefabricated building envelope — a structural frame with your choice of Concrete or GFRC skin, off-the-shelf high-tolerance connections, and up to 4" of factory-installed HFO spray-foam insulation.
